reports.title: RabbitMQ · REST docs → Python exporter
reports.blurb: The full pipeline on a clean run: docs normalized by code, metric surface and IR designed on the standard tier, exporter code generated on the strong tier, then verified by execution. Shows where each token was spent.

reports.title: RabbitMQ · recovering from an upstream API change
reports.blurb: The upstream API was changed underneath a working integration (a renamed field and a newly-nested one). Validation caught it, and repair fixed the exporter in one iteration using fresh endpoint samples as ground truth.

reports.title: SNMP device · IF-MIB → snmp_exporter config
reports.blurb: One model call total: the MIB is parsed deterministically, the model only chooses what to monitor and how to name it, and snmp.yml plus the validation contract are compiled from that same selection so they cannot drift.

reports.title: Legacy switch · SNMP selection self-repair
reports.blurb: A device with no ifXTable, so the 64-bit counters the model preferred do not exist. Repair walked the device, saw which OIDs actually respond, and substituted the 32-bit equivalents rather than dropping throughput coverage.

reports.title: RabbitMQ · documentation ingested over HTTP
reports.blurb: Same pipeline, but the documentation was fetched from a URL and normalized before extraction — the path used for OpenAPI specs and HTML API references.
